svg.title: half_adder: half_adder.sch
svg.desc: Batch Xschem export of the taped-out source; device properties are retained. Primitive crops omit obsolete sizing sidebars. Geometry is not a new layout or verification result.
svg.text: BALANCED TERNARY HALF ADDER / NANY x5 + INV x2
a + b = sum + 3*carry. T and carry are shared internally.
Power/reference ports: VDD = +5 V; VSS = -5 V; VMID = 0 V.
No internal load capacitor. Add load in the parent testbench.
SUM GENERATION / reuse T and CARRY
